title: Cracking ML Interviews
blurb: Implement the classical machine learning toolkit from scratch: linear models, trees and ensembles, clustering, evaluation metrics and preprocessing. Each problem pins down its conventions exactly, the way an interviewer would.
prereq: Comfortable Python and NumPy broadcasting, plus the basics of linear algebra, probability and gradients.
next: Carry these building blocks into neural networks and training loops, or practise turning them into production pipelines in an ML system design setting.
